biological_replicate: protein expression analysis of one hundred eleven melanoma lymph node metastases using high resolution mass spectrometry
experimental_design: correlation of protein expression with patient survival and histopathological features
In order to relate protein expression in lymph node metastatic melanomas to patient survival
factor_value: survival (short, intermediate, long), BRAF status (wild type, V600E, V600A, V600K), tumor cell content
The cohort included 59% of patients with wild type BRAF status and 36% of patients with V600E mutation in the BRAF gene (4% had V600A or V600K mutation)
number_of_biological_replicates: A total of 111 patients diagnosed with melanoma metastasis between 1975 and 2011 were evaluated in the study
number_of_samples: A total of 111 patients diagnosed with melanoma metastasis between 1975 and 2011 were evaluated in the study
